section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1988
title: 29 #### 2.7 Distribution Of Suicides By Sex : 2.7.1. During 1988, 58.7% of the total suicides were committed by males and 41.3% by females in the country, while in the States as a whole this percentage of males was 58.8% and of females 41.2%. The 'Male' and 'Female' ratio of suicides for the Union Territories as a whole was 54.2% and 45.8% respectively, while for the 12 Metropolitan Cities taken together it was 51.2% and 48.8% respectively. The percentage of male suicides in 15 States and 4 Union Territories was higher than the all-India average of 58.7%, while in all the Metropolitan Cities, the percentage of male victims of the suicides was lower than the all-India average.
